propositions: A single project's transport error (400/401/403/404/429/5xx/timeout) in the base-query loop currently aborts the entire pass for all projects; per-project isolation is missing.
The fetcher's enrichment loop already implements per-project fault isolation and fail-open behavior; the base-query loop never inherited this resilience.
A per-project base-query transport error must emit a fetcher-project-fetch-failed alert and continue processing other projects without aborting the pass.

A _fetch_project helper (symmetric to _enrich_project) must drain both active and done-recent queries into a local dict and merge only on success, ensuring no partial keys from failed projects leak into the shared snapshot.
Syntactically-invalid/absent project keys and BackendPaginationStallError exceptions must still fail closed and re-raise, preserving existing validation and truncation semantics.
